reference: She said she wanted one exactly like it.
sk: Povedala, že chce presne taký istý.
acceptable: She said {that |}she wanted {exactly the same one|the exact same one|one exactly the same}.

mistakes.text: She said {that |}she wants one exactly like it.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „said“ sa v Reported speech Present Simple zvyčajne mení na Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „said“ se v Reported speech Present Simple obvykle mění na Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “said”, Reported speech usually moves the Present Simple back to the Past Simple.

mistakes.text: She said {that |}she wanted exactly such one.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Taký“ sa tu neprekladá ako „such one“; povedz „one exactly like it“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Takový“ se tu nepřekládá jako „such one“; řekni „one exactly like it“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Such one” isn't correct English; say “one exactly like it”.

mistakes.text: She said {that |}she wanted exactly like it.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba „one“: „she wanted one exactly like it“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí „one“: „she wanted one exactly like it“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “One” is missing: “she wanted one exactly like it”.

mistakes.text: She told {that |}she wanted one exactly like it.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Tell“ potrebuje osobu („told me“); bez osoby použi „said“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Tell“ potřebuje osobu („told me“); bez osoby použij „said“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Tell” needs a person (“told me”); without one, use “said”.

mistakes.text: She said I want one exactly like it.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Treba Reported speech: „she wanted“ namiesto „I want“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Je potřeba Reported speech: „she wanted“ místo „I want“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Use Reported speech: “she wanted” instead of “I want”.
